privacy.title: How we use your information
privacy.purposes.title: Why we use it
privacy.purposes.text: To create and protect your account, check your identity, run your orders, payments and deliveries, settle disputes and prevent fraud. We do not use it for marketing unless you agree to that separately.
privacy.data.title: What we collect
privacy.data.text: Now: your name, mobile number, e-mail address and password (kept only in a form that cannot be read back). Later, when you use those features: your identity document and selfie, listings, orders, payments, delivery details and messages.
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep it
privacy.retention.text: Identity images: until 30 days after your account closes or a rejected check is not resubmitted. Messages: 1 year after the last one. Dispute files: 2 years after the decision. Payment records: 6 years. Other account data is deleted or anonymised after you close your account. Data needed for an open dispute or a legal request is kept longer.
privacy.recipients.title: Who receives it
privacy.recipients.text: Only what each needs: the payment provider you choose (bKash, Nagad or card), the courier for your delivery, and our SMS and e-mail providers. Authorities receive data only on a documented lawful request.
privacy.location.title: Where it is stored
privacy.location.text: Your identity documents and other sensitive data are stored in Bangladesh.
privacy.rights.title: Your choices
privacy.rights.text: You can withdraw optional consents, download your data or close your account at any time from your account's privacy page.

terms.intro: These terms apply when you use TrustBazaar to buy and sell used goods and game accounts in Bangladesh.
terms.who.title: Who can use TrustBazaar
terms.who.text: You must be 18 or older, keep one account, and give true details. Buying and selling need a verified identity.
terms.payment.title: How payment works
terms.payment.text: When you buy, TrustBazaar holds your payment. The seller is paid when you confirm receipt, or automatically at the time shown on the order unless you open a dispute before then.
terms.bids.title: Bids
terms.bids.text: A bid is a promise to buy at that price if you win. Auctions end on TrustBazaar's clock, and the highest valid bid wins.
terms.fees.title: Fees
terms.fees.text: Sellers pay the commission shown before they publish a listing. Buyers see the full total, including any delivery fee, before they pay.
terms.forbidden.title: What you may not sell
terms.forbidden.text: Anything illegal, stolen, counterfeit or unsafe, and anything the listing rules forbid. Such listings are removed.
terms.game.title: Game accounts
terms.game.text: A game's publisher may forbid account transfers and may suspend or ban an account. TrustBazaar cannot prevent this.
terms.disputes.title: Disputes
terms.disputes.text: If an order goes wrong, open a dispute before its deadline. TrustBazaar staff decide from the evidence both sides give.
terms.rules.title: Breaking the rules
terms.rules.text: Accounts that break these terms or try to cheat others may be limited, suspended or closed.
terms.test.title: Test mode
terms.test.text: This version is a university project. Payments and couriers are simulated, and no real money is moved.
